codeReview.summary: The Redis client implementation fully satisfies the feature requirements. Key patterns (eval:status:{id}, eval:progress:{id}) are correctly implemented with 24-hour TTL. Helper functions for set/get/delete operations work correctly with proper error handling. Connection pool uses go-redis defaults (10 connections per CPU core, 3 retries, 4s pool timeout). 13 comprehensive test cases cover connection, CRUD, TTL, key patterns, updates, and concurrent operations.

issues.description: Test ID generation in TestRedisClientConnectionPoolSettings uses 'string(rune(i))' which produces non-printable control characters for i=0 to 9 (Unicode code points 0-9 are control characters, not the digit characters '0'-'9'). Should use strconv.Itoa(i) or fmt.Sprintf("concurrent-test-%d", i) for proper ID generation. This is a test-only issue and doesn affect production code.

summary: PASS. Redis client implementation is complete and correct. All expected behaviors are implemented: connects to localhost:3106, 24-hour TTL applied automatically, key patterns follow specification, connection pool configured. One minor non-blocking issue in test code (test ID generation uses incorrect string conversion). All 13 tests pass and manual verification confirmed correct Redis behavior.
